content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Deoghar Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 22-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Deoghar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the AIIMS Deoghar Various Posts is 22nd August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Deoghar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for various posts in AIIMS Deoghar. These include Scientist-B (Medical), Research Assistant/ Staff Nurse, and Lab Technician positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Scientist-B (Medical) post?
faq.answer: For the Scientist-B (Medical) post, candidates must possess an MBBS degree recognized by the MCI. Prior lab experience in Virology, Microbiology, Immunology, or Parasitology is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Lab Technician post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Lab Technician post is 30 years as of 07th August 2026. Age relaxation will be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for AIIMS Deoghar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via email. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it along with required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Research Assistant/ Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Assistant/ Staff Nurse (optional) post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 35,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. Does AIIMS Deoghar offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation for reserved categories is typically provided as per government rules and regulations. Specific details can be found in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves the scrutiny of applications, followed by an interview. A written test may be conducted if the number of eligible candidates exceeds 30 per post.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of AIIMS Deoghar. Please check the 'Important Links' section for the website address.

faq.question: Q10. What documents need to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and two recent passport-size color photographs with the application form.
